title: Add path parameters and wildcards to the router
prompt: The router in this project (`src/router.js`) only matches static paths. Extend it as described in README.md: `:param` segments, a trailing `*` wildcard, route priority (static beats parameter beats wildcard, regardless of the order routes were added), and a parsed `query` on the match result, plus `allowedMethods(url)`. Existing static routing must keep working. Run the tests with `npm test`.
